section.content: 在包括输入级输入缓冲电路的半导体集成电路中，输入缓冲电路的输入端连接到输入MOS晶体管的栅电极，该栅电极的栅长度大于按实用设计规则指定的栅极长度。另一种办法是，在半导体集成电路的门阵列系统中，形成预定数目的、具有大于按实用设计规则指定的栅极长度的栅电极。输入缓冲电路的输入晶体管是这样形成的，使得所述栅电极之一的栅长度大于按实用设计规则指定的栅极长度。

In a semiconductor integrated circuit including an input-stage input buffer circuit, an input terminal of the input buffer circuit is connected to a grid electrode of an input MOS transistor which has a grid electrode length longer than a grid electrode length specified in the applied design rule. Alternatively mean is, in a gate array system of a semiconductor integrated circuit, forming a destined number of gates have a gate length longer than the length specified in an applied design rule. An input transistor of the input buffer circuit is formed in this way, let one of the said grid electrode has length longer than a gate length specified in the applied design rule.

Semiconductor integrated circuitThe present invention relates to the semiconductor integrated circuit that input stage has improved surge protection function.More precisely, the present invention relates to comprise the improvement of input buffer circuit input stage in the semiconductor integrated circuit of gate array system.

Because semiconductor device development in integrated always, its size is reducing, and particularly in the MOS device, electrostatic breakdown becomes an important problem, because the MOS device has extra high input impedance.The static of semiconductor device is subjected to the influence of temperature and humidity, and reduces with temperature rising and humidity increase usually.Static is subjected to the influence of humidity very big.When relative humidity reaches 40 to 50% or more hour, static can significantly increase.

The chip puncture that static causes roughly is divided into three kinds of patterns.First pattern is inner lead fusing, for example aluminium or polysilicon lead-in wire fusing, and second pattern is that oxide-film punctures, three-mode is that the bonding part punctures.Fusing as gold thread or this class lead-in wire of fine aluminum wire may puncture generation with above-mentioned chip.

Three kinds of above-mentioned patterns often combine appearance.On the other hand,, do not see defect in appearance, but the leakage current of knot can increase or transistorized multiplication factor can reduce damaging under the lighter situation.Therefore, under the situation of MOS device, in input is slow, in the circuit surge protection circuit is arranged usually, avoid static damage with the protection internal circuit.

Fig. 5 represents the circuit diagram of the input stage of ordinary semiconductor integrated circuit.

In being shown in the common input stage circuit of Fig. 5, input pad 1 is received input signal.Input signal is delivered to input buffer circuit 2 through resistance 11 then.Circuit 2 comprised P channel MOS transistor 6 and N-channel MOS transistor 8 during input was slow, and they are connected in series between power supply potential node 4 and the earth potential node 7.Transistor 6 and each grid of 8 all are connected to input node 3.Interconnector 9 and 10 is connected respectively to the input node 3 and the output node 5 of input buffer circuit 2.

First diode 12 is connected between input pad 1 and the power supply potential node 4.Second diode 13 is connected between input pad 1 and the earth potential node 7.Diode 12 or 13 open circuits by source-gate short (off-state) P raceway groove or N-channel MOS transistor constitute.Resistance 11, first diode 12 and second diode 13 play a part surge protection circuit.

Fig. 6 be shown in the input of input stage of Fig. 5 slow in the layout of circuit 2.

Under the situation of as shown in Figure 6 cmos gate array, P channel MOS transistor 6 comprises grid 6a and the 6b that is made by polysilicon, and they are connected to power supply potential node 4; Polysilicon gate 6c, it is between grid 6a and the 6b; By the formed drain region 6d of P type doped region, it is on the plane of Semiconductor substrate between grid 6a and the 6c; And by the formed source region 6e of P type doped region, it is on the plane of Semiconductor substrate between grid 6b and the 6c.

In addition, as shown in Figure 6, N-channel MOS transistor 8 comprises: by grid 8a and 8b that polysilicon is made, they are connected to earth potential node 7; Polysilicon gate 8c, it is between grid 8a and the 8b; By the formed drain region 8d of N type doped region, it is on the plane of Semiconductor substrate between grid 8a and the 8c; And by the formed source region 8e of N type doped region, it is on the plane of Semiconductor substrate between grid 8b and the 8c.

The grid 6c of P channel MOS transistor 6 links to each other with lead 3a with the grid 8c of N-channel MOS transistor 8, and lead 3a is the aluminium film that forms on grid 6c and 8c, and corresponding to the input node 3 of Fig. 5.

When the circuit operation that is shown in Fig. 5 and Fig. 6, when the surge voltage that is equal to or higher than supply voltage was added to input pad 1, surge flow to power supply by first diode 12.Be added to input during pad 1 when being equal to or less than earthy surge voltage, surge is absorbed by ground by second diode 13.

Fig. 7 is the circuit diagram of the another kind of input circuit form of expression ordinary semiconductor integrated circuit, and it is disclosed by Japanese patent application bulletin 95-208771.

In Fig. 7, two transistor 14a and 14b link the input pad 1 of input buffer circuit 2 of the input stage of semiconductor integrated circuit.Two transistor 14a and 14b have first diode 12 structure similar with second diode 13 as shown in Figure 5, and have the surge absorption function.Fig. 7 label identical with the label of Fig. 5, same or analogous element among expression and Fig. 5, so, no longer be described in detail.

The surge protection circuit of the input buffer circuit of general semiconductor integrated circuit input level constitutes as Fig. 5 or Fig. 7 are described.In those semiconductor integrated circuit with gate array methods, the regular transistor that is used for the input buffer circuit of input stage is that the form with electric capacity or diode is connected to the input pad.So just obtain surge protection effect to a certain degree.,, need can do with surge protection circuit, also require to reduce at the shared area of semiconductor chip than the higher surge protection function of having of high surge voltage for the input buffer circuit of semiconductor integrated circuit input stage.

A target of the present invention provides a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, and it has higher surge protection function and can not increase specific area on the semiconductor chip for this reason and greatly.

According to an aspect of the present invention, in the semiconductor integrated circuit of the input buffer circuit that comprises input stage, the input of input buffer circuit is connected on the minimum gate electrode of a minimum input transistors, and this transistorized grid length is greater than the grid length by the appointment of practical design rule.

In another aspect of this invention, in semiconductor integrated circuit, described input transistors is made of MOS transistor.

In another aspect of this invention, another transistorized gate electrode that plays the electric capacity effect is connected to the input that middle circuit is delayed in input in semiconductor integrated circuit.

In another aspect of this invention, in semiconductor integrated circuit, described another transistor is made of MOS transistor.

According to a further aspect in the invention, semiconductor integrated circuit comprises a gate array system.The gate array system comprises a plurality of gate electrodes that form according to the practical design rule.The gate array system further comprises the gate electrode of predetermined number, and its grid length is greater than the grid length by the appointment of practical design rule.

In another aspect of this invention, in the semiconductor integrated circuit that comprises the gate array system, in the gate array system, form the input stage input buffer circuit.The input transistors of input buffer circuit forms with a kind of like this form, and promptly the grid length of one of its gate electrode is greater than the grid length by the appointment of practical design rule.

In another aspect of this invention, in the semiconductor integrated circuit that comprises the gate array system, the mode with electric capacity in the gate array system forms another transistor, and described another transistorized gate electrode is connected to the gate electrode of input transistors.

According to a further aspect in the invention, semiconductor integrated circuit comprises the gate array system (cell base gate array system) based on the unit.Gate array system based on the unit comprises a plurality of gate electrodes that form according to the practical design rule.Further comprise the gate electrode of predetermined number based on the gate array system of unit, its grid length is greater than the grid length by the appointment of practical design rule.

In another aspect of this invention, in a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit that comprises based on the gate array system of unit, in based on the gate array system of unit, form the input buffer circuit of input stage.The input transistors of circuit formed by this way during this input was slow, and promptly the grid length of one of its gate electrode is greater than the grid length by the appointment of practical design rule.

In another aspect of this invention, in a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit that comprises based on the gate array system of unit, in this gate array system based on the unit, at least have another transistor to form, and described another transistorized gate electrode is connected to the gate electrode of input transistors with the form of electric capacity.

First embodiment

Below in conjunction with Fig. 1 and Fig. 2 the first embodiment of the present invention is described.Fig. 1 is the input stage circuit figure of the semiconductor integrated circuit of first embodiment of the invention.Fig. 2 is the semiconductor chip layout that is shown in the input stage input buffer circuit of Fig. 1.

In being shown in the input stage circuit of Fig. 1, input pad 1 forms on Semiconductor substrate, and is connected to lead terminal by lead-in wire, and input signal is added to this lead terminal.

Circuit 2 was received input signal from 1 connection of above-mentioned input pad during the input of internal circuit was slow.Circuit 2 comprised P channel MOS transistor 6 and N-channel MOS transistor 8 during input was slow.P channel MOS transistor 6 is connected between power supply potential node 4 and the output node 5, and its grid is connected to input node 3.N-channel MOS transistor 8 is connected between earth potential node 7 and the output node 5, and its grid is connected to input node 3.

Inner lead 9 is connected to the input node 3 of the slow middle circuit 2 of input.Inner lead 10 is connected to the output node 5 of input buffer circuit 2.

Resistance 11 is connected between the input node 3 of input pad 1 and input buffer circuit 2.

Arrange first diode 12 like this, be about to its anode and be connected to input pad 1, its negative electrode is connected to power supply potential node 4.First diode 12 comprises the open circuit p channel transistor of its source gate short.Arrange second diode 13 like this, be about to its negative electrode and be connected to input pad 1, its anode is connected to earth potential node 7.Second diode 13 comprises the open circuit N channel transistor of its source gate short.

Resistance 11, first diode 12 and second diode 13 constitute the surge protection circuit of input buffer circuit 2.

In the running of the circuit that is shown in Fig. 1, when when input pad 1 adds the surge voltage that is equal to or higher than supply voltage, surge flows to power supply through first diode 12.When adding when being equal to or less than earthy surge voltage through input pad 1, surge is absorbed by ground through second diode 13.

In the circuit diagram of the input stage of semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention first most preferred embodiment that is shown in Fig. 1, can't see it has any difference with the input stage circuit figure that is shown in the general semiconductor integrated circuit of Fig. 5., the layout of the input buffer circuit by relatively being shown in Fig. 2 and the layout that is shown in the common input buffer circuit of Fig. 6 just can be known their difference.

In the layout of the input buffer circuit that utilizes cmos gate array that is shown in Fig. 2, P channel MOS transistor 6 comprises: gate electrode 6a and 6b that polysilicon is made, and they are connected to power supply potential node 4; The gate electrode 6cx that polysilicon is made, it is configured between grid 6a and the 6b; The source region 6e that constitutes by P type doped region that on a drain region 6d that constitutes by P type doped region that forms on the plane of Semiconductor substrate between grid 6a and the 6cx and a plane, forms in Semiconductor substrate between grid 6b and the 6cx.

In addition, as shown in Figure 2, N-channel MOS transistor 8 comprises: gate electrode 8a and 8b that polysilicon is made, and they are connected on the earth potential node 7; The gate electrode 8cx that polysilicon is made, it is configured between grid 8a and the 8b; The drain region 8d that constitutes by N type doped region that on a plane of Semiconductor substrate between grid 8a and the 8cx, forms; And the source region 8e that constitutes by N type doped region that on a plane of Semiconductor substrate between grid 8b and the 8cx, forms.

With lead 3a the grid 8cx of the grid 6cx of P channel MOS transistor 6 and N-channel MOS transistor 8 is coupled together, this lead 3a is the aluminium lamination that forms on each grid 6cx and 8cx, and this lead 3a is corresponding with the input node 3 of Fig. 5.

Opposite with the slow middle circuit arrangement map of the common input that is shown in Fig. 6, in the input buffer circuit layout of first embodiment shown in Figure 2, the length of each input grid 6cx and 8cx of P channel MOS transistor 6 and N-channel MOS transistor 8 is all done to such an extent that be longer than grid length by the appointment of practical design rule, and, increased the input capacitance of importing slow middle circuit 2.So just improved anti surge voltage; and compare with the slow middle circuit of the input of ordinary semiconductor integrated circuit; improved the surge protection function; in the input buffer circuit of ordinary semiconductor integrated circuit; the input grid 6c of P channel MOS transistor 6 and N-channel MOS transistor 8 and the length of 8c are the full-length by the appointment of practical design rule, as shown in Figure 6.

Second embodiment

Below with reference to Fig. 3 and Fig. 4 the second embodiment of the present invention is described.

Fig. 3 is the circuit diagram of the semiconductor integrated circuit input stage of second embodiment of the invention.Fig. 4 is the semiconductor chip layout that is shown in the input stage input buffer circuit of Fig. 3.In Fig. 3 and Fig. 4, the identical or corresponding elements of representing with identical label among label 1 to 13 presentation graphs 1 Fig. 2.

Input pad 1 receiving inputted signal.The input buffer circuit 2 of internal circuit connects by resistance 11 from above-mentioned input pad 1 receives this input signal.Diode 12 and 13 and resistance 11 play a part surge protection circuit.At this, structure and the operation about input stage circuit part identical with first embodiment are described no longer.

In a second embodiment, as shown in Figure 3, first electric capacity 14 and 15 additions of second electric capacity.First electric capacity 14 is connected between the input node 3 and power supply potential node 4 of input buffer circuit 2.Second electric capacity 15 is connected between the input node 3 and earth potential node 7 of input buffer circuit 2.

First electric capacity 14 comprises the P channel MOS transistor, its source and leak short circuit on electric.The gate electrode 14a of first electric capacity 14 is connected to input node 3 places of input buffer circuit 2, and its source and drain electrode are connected to power supply potential node 4.

Second electric capacity 15 comprises the N-channel MOS transistor, its source and leak short circuit on electric.The gate electrode 15a of second electric capacity 15 is connected to input node 3 places of input buffer circuit 2, and its source and drain electrode are connected to earth potential node 7.

Fig. 4 is the slow middle layout of circuit on semiconductor chip of input stage input that is included among Fig. 3.

In being shown in the layout that utilizes cmos gate array of Fig. 4, electric capacity 14 and 15 is connected respectively to the P channel MOS transistor 6 of formation input buffer circuit 2 and the input grid 6cx and the 8cx of N-channel MOS transistor 8.

Has standard grid length as the MOS transistor 14 and 15 of electric capacity by the appointment of practical design rule.

First electric capacity 14 is set together with P channel MOS transistor 6, and the latter comprises grid 6a and the 6b that is made by polysilicon, and they are connected to power supply potential node 4, and is connected to input node 3 by the grid 6ex that polysilicon is made.

The grid 14a of P channel MOS transistor 14 is arranged between grid 6cx and the 6b.Zone 14b and 14c are formed by P type doped region respectively, and short each other the connection.Shorting region 14b and 14c are connected to power supply potential node 4.

Second electric capacity 15 is set together with N-channel MOS transistor 8, and the latter comprises grid 8a and the 8b that is made by polysilicon, and they are connected to earth potential node 7, and is connected to input node 3 by the grid 8cx that polysilicon is made.

The grid 15a of P channel MOS transistor 15 is arranged between grid 8cx and the 8b.Zone 15b and 15c are formed by N type doped region respectively, and short each other the connection.Shorting region 15b and 15c are connected to earth potential node 7.

Aluminium lamination lead 16 is by tie point 16a to 16d, promptly, embed each the aluminium lamination contact in the contact hole, the grid 8cx of the grid 6cx of P channel MOS transistor 6, N-channel MOS transistor 8, on electric, couple together as the grid 14a of an electrode of first electric capacity 14 with as the grid 15a of an electrode of second electric capacity 15.Aluminium lamination lead 16 plays a part to be shown in the input node 3 of the input buffer circuit 2 of Fig. 3.

The course of work of input buffer circuit that is shown in Fig. 3 and Fig. 4 is as follows.

MOS element 14 and 15 electric capacity are added to the input node 3 of input buffer circuit 2.Therefore, compare with first embodiment, the gate area S of the essence of input buffer circuit 2 has further increased.Thus; even when the input pad 1 of surge by Fig. 3 is added on the circuit; and overvoltage appears in 3 places at the input node; electric field between gate electrode 6cx or 8ex and source or leakage diffusion region rises and also can be controlled; be appreciated that this point from following expression, thereby improved the surge protection function.

With reference to the cutaway view that is shown in the common MOS transistor of Fig. 8, the electric field strength E between gate electrode G and diffusion region S or D is provided by following formula, and reduces along with the increase of gate area.

E＝V/d＝Q/Cd＝Q/eS

Wherein, E is the electric field strength between gate electrode and the diffusion region, and V is the voltage between gate electrode and the diffusion region, and d is the distance between gate electrode and the diffusion region, and e is a dielectric constant, and Q is the quantity of electric charge, and S is a gate area.

Like this, in a second embodiment, further improved the anti surge voltage of input buffer circuit 2, and, improved the surge protection function of input buffer circuit 2 by the structure of first embodiment and capacity cell 14 and 15 are combined.

A third embodiment in accordance with the invention, in the semiconductor integrated circuit that comprises the gate array system, predetermined number, as depicted in figs. 1 and 2, have greater than transistor 6 and 8 by the gate electrode of the grid length of practical design rule appointment, form in the gate array main body with a plurality of transistors that have by the standard grid length of practical design rule.Utilize transistor or have the input buffer circuit that constitutes input stage greater than transistor by the grid length of practical design rule appointment.

A fourth embodiment in accordance with the invention, in the semiconductor integrated circuit that comprises based on the gate array system of unit, transistor 6 predetermined number, as depicted in figs. 1 and 2 and 8 such, have greater than transistor by the grid length of practical design rule appointment, with a plurality of have by the transistor of the standard grid length of practical design rule appointment form with standard cell (standard cells) form.Utilize transistor or have greater than the transistor by the grid length of practical design rule appointment constitute the input of input stage slow in circuit.

Like this, can be according to different anti surge voltage requirements, easily constitute based on the input of the semiconductor integrated circuit of the gate array system of unit slow in circuit.Have input buffer circuit shared area on semiconductor chip of surge protection circuit can reduce to minimum, and the surge protection function can be optimized.

In the present invention, the input stage input buffer circuit of semiconductor integrated circuit is made of the transistor that has greater than by the grid length of practical design rule appointment.Thus, improved the anti surge voltage of surge protection circuit, and improved the surge protection performance, and the increase of the shared area of the surge protection circuit on chip can be controlled.

In addition, in the present invention, in the semiconductor integrated circuit that comprises based on the gate array system of unit, predetermined number, have greater than transistor by the grid length of practical design rule appointment, with a plurality of have by the transistor of the standard grid length of practical design rule appointment form with the standard cell of gate array system form.Can be according to different anti surge voltage requirements, utilize the transistor that has greater than by the grid length of practical design rule appointment to constitute the input stage input buffer circuit.Another kind of way is, can selected number, have the input grid that is connected to the input transistors that constitutes the input stage input buffer circuit by the transistor of the standard grid length of practical design rule appointment, as mos capacitance.So just optimized the anti surge voltage of surge protection circuit, and improved the surge protection performance of circuit, and the increase of the shared area of the circuit on chip is reduced to minimum.
